7.1.3.1.2 Status check
[SWS_LinIf_00874] ⌈If Bus Mirroring is enabled globally (configuration parameter
LinIfBusMirroringSupported) and has been activated with a call to LinIf_-
EnableBusMirroring() for a LIN channel, the LIN Interface shall call Mirror_Re-
portLinFrame() each time after reading the LIN Driver’s status for a Tx slot on that
channel, providing the transmitted data when the status is LIN_TX_OK, and otherwise
a NULL pointer.⌋
